name: aonarr
description: AoNarr is a self-hosted media manager that unifies Sonarr/Radarr/Lidarr/Readarr/Prowlarr/Bazarr/Whisparr-style functionality across 10 library types (Movies, TV Shows, Anime, Music, Books, Comics, ROMs, Online Videos, Courses, Adult) in one app. This is the single all-in-one container — API and browser UI run together in one image, avoiding the cross-container networking that "aonarr-server" + "aonarr-web" require. Prefer this unless you specifically want the two containers to scale/update independently. On first boot, open the web UI and create an admin account (username/password) — no API key needed. To skip that screen entirely, set the Admin Username/Password variables below before first start. Point the Downloads and Media paths at the same shares your download client and media library actually use — AoNarr resolves completed downloads and organizes files under Media itself, it doesn't just track them.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Root of your media library — the same share your root folders (configured inside the app) live under.

paths.name: Downloads
paths.description: Shared downloads folder — must be the same path your download client (qBittorrent/SABnzbd) writes completed downloads to.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port the browser UI is served on.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID files are created as — 99 is Unraid's default 'nobody' user.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID files are created as — 100 is Unraid's default 'users' group.

variables.name: Search Interval (minutes)
variables.description: How often the scheduler auto-searches monitored, fileless items.

variables.name: Queue Poll Interval (seconds)
variables.description: How often the scheduler polls download clients for progress.

variables.name: Admin Username
variables.description: Optional: auto-creates the admin account on first boot instead of using the web UI's setup screen. Leave blank to set it up in the browser instead.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Required if Admin Username is set (min 8 characters). For a Docker secret file instead, use AONARR_ADMIN_PASSWORD_FILE.
